osdbConfig.osdbFiles_desc: List of Open Seizure Database files to be used as input for the data preparation

modelConfig._comment_cnnWindow: 1-second windows for CNN feature extraction (25 samples @ 25Hz)
modelConfig._comment_lstmWindow: 30-second sequence for LSTM (will be divided into 1-second CNN features = 30 timesteps)
modelConfig._comment_featureDim: Dimension of CNN feature vectors output to LSTM (restored to 64 for adequate model capacity)
modelConfig._comment_lstmHiddenDim: Number of hidden units in LSTM layers (restored to 128 for learning capacity)
modelConfig._comment_lstmNumLayers: Number of stacked LSTM layers (restored to 2 for temporal modeling)
modelConfig._comment_convDropout: Dropout after convolutional layers in CNN feature extractor (reduced to 0.08 for better learning)
modelConfig._comment_lstmDropout: Dropout between LSTM layers (reduced to 0.25 for improved decision boundary)
modelConfig._comment_denseDropout: Dropout in dense classifier head layers (restored to original 0.15)
modelConfig._comment_posWeightMultiplier: Weight for positive class in loss (< 1.0 penalizes false positives more than false negatives to reduce FPR)
modelConfig._comment_batch: Batch size - reduced from 512 to accommodate LSTM memory requirements
modelConfig._comment_nLayers: Not applicable for CNN-LSTM (architecture is fixed)
modelConfig._comment_testBufferPrefill: Test time only: pre-fill the rolling buffer at each buffer-segment start (event start, or restart after a data gap) so every datapoint is scored. 'repeat' (default) tiles the segment's first real datapoint - deterministic. 'noise' uses Gaussian noise matched to the first datapoint (seeded per event when randomSeed is set). 'stationary' fills with flat 1000 milli-g (legacy; out-of-distribution, inflates start-of-event probabilities). Use 'none' to drop warm-up rows instead. Warm-up datapoints (window still containing pre-fill) are flagged and excluded from alarm decisions in any mode. Training is unaffected.
modelConfig._comment_lr_schedule: Set useLrSchedule to true to enable Spahr et al. 2025 three-phase learning rate schedule
modelConfig._comment_model_selection: Model selection criteria - prevents saving models with poor FPR/TPR balance; be careful not to over-tighten sensitivity when data are highly imbalanced.
modelConfig._comment_metrics: modelSelectionMetric options: 'dual_improvement', 'f1', 'f_beta', 'youden', 'min_fpr'. 'min_fpr' minimizes FPR while maintaining minimum sensitivity (saveBestMinSensitivity). saveBestMaxFpr enforces maximum false positive rate.
modelConfig._comment_batches: Set useBalancedBatches to true for Spahr et al. 2025 balanced batch sampling
modelConfig._comment_subtype_weighting: Optional subtype-aware sampling. Keep disabled until running controlled A/B tests.
